project.title: New Blueprint v2.2 Mathematics Project
project.architecture: unified mathematics and cross-disciplinary claim, inference, evidence, and research-state graph

mainlines.mathematics: propositions, hypotheses, definitions, inferences, proofs, and refutations
mainlines.research: goals, open obligations, candidate routes, and audited failures
mainlines.simulation: numerical contracts, methods, and direct measurements
mainlines.support: cross-mainline definitions, source contracts, and quality gates

epistemic_types.problem_hypothesis: a premise given by the active mathematical problem contract
epistemic_types.definition_contract: a project, problem, or literature definition and notation contract
epistemic_types.external_mathematical_result: a source-verified theorem imported from the literature
epistemic_types.mathematical_claim: a proposition whose truth status may be open, established, refuted, or contested
epistemic_types.mathematical_inference: a first-class multi-premise proof step with its own proof status
epistemic_types.verified_counterexample: a certificate-bound counterexample that refutes named claims
epistemic_types.research_goal: a prove, refute, or prove-or-refute target
epistemic_types.proof_obligation: a precise unresolved substatement or proof gap
epistemic_types.research_attempt: a reusable route, candidate derivation, or audited failure record
epistemic_types.research_claim: a context- and scope-qualified cross-disciplinary claim
epistemic_types.research_inference: a first-class exact, approximate, numerical, empirical, or synthesis inference
epistemic_types.basic_assumption: an externally established generic scientific premise
epistemic_types.theory_from_assumptions: a strict generic derivation from declared assumptions and theory inputs
epistemic_types.numerical_method: an implemented numerical method, detector, or quality gate
epistemic_types.numerical_result: a direct output or measurement from a declared numerical method
epistemic_types.numerical_experiment_design: a planned numerical test without a released result
epistemic_types.theory_from_numerics: an interpretation requiring theory and numerical inputs
epistemic_types.superseded: historical content excluded from current conclusions

evidence_grades.A: kernel-checked proof, exact identity, or independently reproduced controlled result
evidence_grades.B: complete independently audited proof or quality-gated result
evidence_grades.C: rigorous conditional or partial result with explicit scope
evidence_grades.D: open goal, conjecture, candidate proof, blocked route, or experiment design
evidence_grades.X: refuted, contradicted, contested, invalid, or superseded content
